    - [CLAIM-349](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-349.md) — An organization's access to a signal, the signal's authority over action, and action on it are separable, and adaptive regulation keeps the first while making the second conditional on evidence; overcontrol, which buys freedom from harmful acts by cutting access or making inhibition unconditional, is a maladaptive regime and not more control, so flexibility is a context-sensitive property of maintained influence relations, not of how much is inhibited *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-025
      - [CLAIM-403](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-403.md) — A contribution's admission to an organization's inquiry, its recognition in apt terms, its credibility, its uptake into judgements, and its contributor's part in revising the standards of uptake are separable, each possible without the later ones, so an organization can widen access while every channel by which a less authoritative contribution could change the criteria of authority stays closed *(Active)*
      - [CLAIM-425](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-425.md) — A perspective governs itself with respect to social judgement to the extent that it keeps access to others' judgements of it while making their authority over its conduct depend on their grounds, not on their visibility, repetition or attributed plurality; neither absorbing every judgement nor resisting every one meets this, since both let the judgements set the terms of response *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-415
      - [CLAIM-446](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-446.md) — Some persistent anxiety may be governance-maintained rather than belief-maintained: anticipated threat grants defensive processes authority over action, attention and evidence acquisition; under the avoidance that authority selects, the hypotheses that the situation is dangerous and that it is safe predict the same observation, so repeated safety need not correct the threat estimate; relief reinforces the defense without being evidence of danger; and the regime can outlast a corrected belief, its pathology, where present, being defensive authority insensitive to corrective evidence at avoidable cost *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-283, CLAIM-443
        - [CLAIM-445](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-445.md) — A protective regime, in a person, an institution or a system of states, becomes self-maintaining when the interventions it authorizes shift the evidence used to judge its necessity, the authority and resources of those who judge it, the capacities of its constituents or the threat environment itself in ways that favour its continuation; this can happen when the original threat was real and the first protection apt, and it is a failure only where the regime has become less responsive to evidence that it is no longer needed *(Proposed)*

      - [CLAIM-347](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-347.md) — Frustration among an organization's demands is an ordinal fact before it is a quantity: the jointly satisfiable sets of demands form a downward-closed complex whose minimal non-faces are the minimal conflicts, relief is strict enlargement of that complex for the same declared demands, reorganizations that relieve different conflicts are incomparable, and dropping or suppressing a demand is not relief *(Active)*

          - [CLAIM-437](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-437.md) — 'Wanting' and 'liking' are saliences relative to different, overlapping processes, pursuit and consummation, each ranking states by their bearing on its own concerns; valence is then relative to a perspective, every perspective in the negotiation has its own, the system's valence is that of the perspective whose ordering is the negotiation's potential, and ambivalence is strong saliences of opposite sign with no potential absorbing them *(Proposed)*

    - [CLAIM-450](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-450.md) — Three standards for a communicative distinction come apart: statistical distinguishability of an interpreter's response profiles, measured locally by the Fisher metric and never raised by a parameter-independent garbling; usability by a bounded receiver, which a transformation can raise; and pragmatic efficacy in the act; and where response models are singular, as Watanabe's theory treats, a missing response can come from an absent attempt or an unresponsive receiver alike, and only intervention or later dynamics separate them *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-199
- [CLAIM-141](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-141.md) — Causal-loop consistency and sheaf contextuality are both local-to-global problems, but passing to distributions affects them oppositely: a loop with no deterministic solution has a distributional fixed point, while a model with no global section in its supports has no global distribution either *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-342](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-342.md) — What keeps a judgement–observation loop from confirming itself is evidence whose arrival or scoring does not pass through the interpretation it tests; action is one source of such evidence, not a necessary one, and a loop that selects its own evidence can lock in with action available *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-330
    - [CLAIM-402](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-402.md) — Predictive success of a category across contexts warrants treating it as a real effective kind only when the evidence in those contexts does not pass through the category's own use, or when the effect of that use is modelled: a category that speakers or institutions act on can produce the regularities that confirm it, and contexts that share its use are not independent *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-413](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-413.md) — Grounding is not a property of an experience but a relation among an interpretation, what it purports to be about, and a process that constrains it independently; its current, developmental and epistemic senses come apart from one another, and in the current sense it comes apart from whether the interpretation occurs, so ungrounded is not unconstrained, and what makes an interpretive organization experiential need not be what makes its contents veridical *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-150](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-150.md) — An ontology of intrinsically individuated objects with relational properties can reproduce the categorical and operational identifications, and the predictions, of a relational one, so identification underdetermines constitution *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-152](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-152.md) — Any individuation built on sufficiency is relative to the target it is sufficient for: fix the outcomes differently and a different partition wins, so no boundary drawn this way is universal *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-157](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-157.md) — Relative to a stated target, a combined form is one system while its joint dynamics are nearly decomposable with the form as a block whose gap beats the Occam factor, and it lasts as long as that block persists; the unit is the gap-isolated block, not any member *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-154, CLAIM-164
    - [CLAIM-174](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-174.md) — A candidate factor is an agent at a level when it is one system there, when a goal-directed description beats a device description by more than the Occam cost, and when its policy would adapt if its actions' consequences changed; it is a willed agent when, further, a will-organization over several regimes describes it better than none, and what passes that is the jurisdiction of a will-organization *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-154
      - [CLAIM-367](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-367.md) — Whether a training-time regulatory condition belongs to a network depends on which unit is individuated for the training dynamics and whose jurisdiction governs the updates; in conventional training most of that governance falls to the optimizer–model–data system, so a condition of training is not thereby a condition of the network *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-027, CLAIM-152, CLAIM-170
  - [CLAIM-405](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-405.md) — An individuation is well defined only once its criterion is fixed (the target it serves, the transformations its unity must survive, the scale), and that dependence does not make it arbitrary: once the criterion is fixed a verdict can be false, and differently fixed criteria can pick out units of one system whose boundaries cross rather than nest, none of them less real for it *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-477](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-477.md) — Relata stand to relations as realizations stand to specifications: what an entity is, is partly fixed by the constraints on the configurations of entities and relations it can enter, and those constraints are themselves realized and maintained by something, so neither relata nor relations, nor specifications nor realizations, are prior without qualification *(Proposed)*
      - [CLAIM-478](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-478.md) — Scale separation helps make structure and not only marks it: where some degrees of freedom settle fast relative to others, the relation they settle into is a constraint on the system over the window between the two time scales, so what is a realization at one scale works as a constraint at another; and organization can make new separations in turn, as when modes slow near an instability and become order parameters, so time-scale hierarchies and constraints can produce one another *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-331
- [CLAIM-154](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-154.md) — A candidate structure is worth naming as a unit when its effect-to-noise ratio outruns the Occam cost of keeping it: reify when d'² exceeds the log prior-to-posterior variance ratio, where the model with the candidate stays regular at the parameters that switch it off *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-332](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-332.md) — A loosely organized population can change what an outside institution does through its members' separately motivated acts of making, selecting and passing things on, without forming a collective intention or judgment, when the organized pattern of those acts, and not only the acts of identifiable individuals, earns its place in explaining the change *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-160](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-160.md) — Data written for a potential future receiver has its intended meaning fixed by the write: even if it is never read, what it was meant to say was settled when it was stored *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-164](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-164.md) — What a spectral gap makes definite is the subspace of the cluster it isolates, not a single direction: the gap picks the object, and the object is a vector only when its own gap is wide *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-169](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-169.md) — On Ainslie's account the population of interests is produced by desynchronized valuation, not given by a fixed architecture: an agent is many interests over a choice only as far as its valuations of that choice cross within the choice's horizon *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-162](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-162.md) — In flow an activity's immediate reward and its longer-run value coincide, so no interest has to be overridden (synchronization as non-crossing valuations, with no dynamical mechanism claimed), and that is why focused action in flow is reported as effortless *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-016](../record/arguments.d/ARG-016.md)
    - [CLAIM-441](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-441.md) — Flow tells against the potential account's condition that valence is undefined where no pair is contested: on the record's own account of flow nothing is overridden because an activity's immediate reward and its longer-run value coincide, yet flow is reported as positive, so either flow's positivity is intrinsic pleasantness and not goal-conduciveness valence, or flow keeps contested pairs its processes settle among themselves, or the positivity comes after the episode and not during it, or the condition is wrong *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-198](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-198.md) — Preference reversal is not yet disunity: interests that govern a choice at disjoint times glue, and a self is divided over a choice only on an overlap, which the agent's prediction of its own later valuation creates *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-197
- [CLAIM-170](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-170.md) — The agents in a system are a factorization of it relative to a level of description and a target; agents in general are identified by adaptation, and willed agents are individuated by their will-organization: a willed agent is the jurisdiction of a will-organization *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-177](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-177.md) — In the record's exchanges with collaborators who keep no memory, the argument repeatedly loses identity: concepts are redefined silently, objections and readings come back as though new, and the thesis changes without anyone arguing for the change *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-178](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-178.md) — A manuscript should be a view over the argument and not its only copy: a draft written straight from an exchange drops commitments and changes its thesis without saying so, and both become visible only against a record where claims carry status and inclusion separately *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-324
    - [CLAIM-183](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-183.md) — Generated views of the record, fed back into the exchange, become instruments of the argument: they show where its terms evolved faster than its formalism *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-189](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-189.md) — Fidelity is the wrong measure of a developing argument: maturing drops and changes things legitimately, so what a record can secure is traceability, change that is announced and located, not preservation *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-034, CLAIM-270
  - [CLAIM-182](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-182.md) — Storage is not anchoring, addressability is: a structure that is kept but cannot be pointed at part by part does not stop re-derivation, and the same content becomes an anchor once its parts get addresses *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-180](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-180.md) — Drift is retrieval failure outside a critical distance: a restatement close enough to an idea retrieves it, one that has drifted too far is taken for new, and a code bypasses retrieval by content altogether *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-177
    - [CLAIM-191](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-191.md) — Restating an argument across memoryless sessions is iterated transport with only a weak channel back to the source: without anchors, restatements drift toward the collaborators' own framings rather than at random, and a code restores continuity of transmission *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-002, CLAIM-177, CLAIM-267, CLAIM-270
  - [CLAIM-185](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-185.md) — The nucleation threshold of an argument is whatever makes a structure persist: a persistent structure is available as an anchor, and more complex structure can evolve only on anchors *(Proposed)*
    - [CLAIM-176](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-176.md) — Recurrence is the trigger of persistence this record is built around: coding a thing the second time it turns up captures exactly the drift that defeats an argument, and keeps capture from flooding the record *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-177, CLAIM-483
  - [CLAIM-186](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-186.md) — How fast an argument grows sets how it grows: drift tracks how fast new material arrives relative to how fast it is anchored, so a fast, prolific exchange branches, as a crystal grown far from equilibrium does, and a project memory stabilizes an argument by keeping anchoring up with arrival *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-483](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-483.md) — An argument developed with collaborators who keep no memory fails mainly at identity and not at structure, so that coding what recurs, not argument mapping, is the remedy, and this holds beyond one owner and one assistant family *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-181](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-181.md) — The record fixes the grammar an argument is expressed in, though not its shape: its closed vocabulary of schemes, roles and relations formalizes early, and a move that fits no CLAIM, TERM, ARG or declared relation is forced into one or lost until the misfit is noticed and the grammar amended to hold it *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-190](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-190.md) — The anchoring measures are computed in the grammar that shapes the argument, so by themselves they cannot certify that drift fell: drift must also be judged under standards the record did not supply *(Superseded)* — also rests on CLAIM-264, CLAIM-266
- [CLAIM-197](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-197.md) — Sections over contexts that do not overlap always glue, so a sense that differs between disjoint contexts is not a gluing failure: a failure needs an overlap carrying sections that disagree, and which families count as covers decides whether anything glues *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-196](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-196.md) — A person's roles in contexts that do not meet cannot contradict one another: role conflict needs an overlap, which segregating audiences prevents and collapsed contexts create *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-317
- [CLAIM-199](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-199.md) — Blackwell's order bounds what a rendering makes possible for any receiver, and a given receiver's access is usable information relative to the rules it can apply, which a garbling can raise for that receiver but never above what the source makes possible *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-263](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-263.md) — Whether two trained networks compute the same way can be tested by quotienting the architecture's full symmetry group and measuring what remains: a barrier that survives alignment marks a different mechanism, connection after alignment means shared feature structure, and the test cannot run where features have no counterpart *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-187](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-187.md) — Whether two systems compute the same way can be tested by quotienting the full admissible symmetry group and measuring what remains: a residual barrier marks a different mechanism, and a feature with no counterpart blocks the comparison *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-264
- [CLAIM-264](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-264.md) — Two objects can agree on every probe in a restricted family without being isomorphic, so equivalence under a probe family is coarser than identity unless the family is rich enough *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-322](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-322.md) — Agreement under a probe family is evidence that two objects share structure only to the degree that the family was chosen independently of the comparison and is evaluated on cases it was not chosen on, so a family selected to make two objects look alike shows only that it can be selected *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-142](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-142.md) — Two communicative realizations can agree on every probe in a restricted family without being structurally identical, so observational equivalence is relative to the probes, and only independently justified probes evaluated on held-out cases are evidence that structure was preserved *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-011, CLAIM-046, CLAIM-264
      - [CLAIM-129](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-129.md) — A factorization recovers only the structure visible in the relations it is fitted to, so a topic can survive a transformation that changes the communicative act, and a kind must be tested against probe families chosen for their bearing on the act *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-004, CLAIM-061
      - [CLAIM-133](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-133.md) — Communicative identity is relational continuity under admissible transformation: translation transports relationally organized observational structure, correspondence fixes what can be compared, admissibility which transformations count, and fidelity which communicatively consequential distinctions remain recoverable *(Superseded)* — also rests on CLAIM-011, CLAIM-050, CLAIM-077, CLAIM-143
      - [CLAIM-139](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-139.md) — A communicative kind's identity is grounded in its relational organization rather than in any expression or encoding; statistical methods recover aspects of that organization from restricted observations, translation transports it, and fidelity is which independently identifiable, decision-relevant relational distinctions persist *(Superseded)* — through [ARG-029](../record/arguments.d/ARG-029.md) — also rests on CLAIM-050, CLAIM-077, CLAIM-135, CLAIM-151; also argued from CLAIM-046, CLAIM-112
      - [CLAIM-204](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-204.md) — A communicative kind's identity is grounded in its relational organization, for which competent participants' uptake is the standard; statistical methods recover aspects of it from restricted observations; translation transports it; and what persists is what the receivers can still recover, of which the analyst can certify the independently identifiable part *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-050, CLAIM-077, CLAIM-135, CLAIM-151, CLAIM-217, CLAIM-223
- [CLAIM-265](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-265.md) — Local descriptions that disagree are not thereby incompatible: whether they obstruct a joint description is decided only relative to a specified class of admissible correspondences between their observations, and a correspondence admitted only because it removes the disagreement decides nothing *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-266](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-266.md) — A family of probes that supplies an optimized system's training signal cannot also certify what the system preserves: optimization pushes toward whatever the probes reward, including what they cannot see, so preservation must be shown under probes not used to train it *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-267](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-267.md) — Per-step discrepancies between a chain of maps and a reference chain compound through the sensitivity of the later steps, so the same local error can be damped, accumulated or amplified, and closeness at every step can coexist with large end-to-end divergence *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-268](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-268.md) — Model stitching certifies an order of information only in its reconstruction form: a map fitted to reproduce the target layers shows the source representation is at least as informative for every decision on the label, task-loss stitching compares one decision problem through a fixed head, and a failure to stitch is no evidence against sufficiency *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-270](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-270.md) — Retaining information about where a Markov chain started and staying close to the starting distribution are different properties: a chain can forget its initial state while its distribution stays far from where it began, so convergence is not preservation and losing information about the origin is not degradation *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-225](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-225.md) — Blackwell's order measures what an ideal decision-maker could do, not what a given receiver can reconstruct, and the line's claims that a rendering can improve access describe garblings that real receivers do better with, which is the shape of the Blackwell thesis's own defeat condition *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-087](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-087.md) — Cross-modal reconstruction often improves a receiver's access to an implicit communicative relation beyond the text-only baseline, as when posture or expression conveys solidarity better than the source text's literal content, though a rendering made without the situation is a garbling and cannot improve what an ideal receiver could do *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-275](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-275.md) — An intervention can come before the interpretation it makes available, so in an organization of processes meaning, policy and influence can co-evolve, and none of them is upstream of the others in every case *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-430](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-430.md) — An interaction can make available a way of relating that its participants' operative perspectives did not hold, by giving each a role to enact in it, so that taking part can come before, and help produce, the reinterpretation it later seems to express; whether the change stays with the partner, generalizes to a category, or is reproduced beyond the encounter are further questions *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-279](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-279.md) — Whether an intervention stabilizes or destabilizes a pattern is relative to a policy and a frame, so denoiser, critic and re-noiser are regimes an operator falls into, not kinds of operator *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-282](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-282.md) — Forbidding self-endorsement does not stop an operator from amplifying its own authority: once endorsement can carry authority more than one hop, reciprocal and cyclic endorsements recycle it, and only one-hop allocation within an epoch makes an operator's authority independent of its own endorsements *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-277](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-277.md) — Durable authority among an organization's processes need not be a primitive: trust can be the temporal regularity of endorsement that policies earn by being right often, and the same loop entrenches whatever gained influence early *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-297](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-297.md) — When an operator's authority is updated by how well it performs on the interpretation it helped make dominant, the coupled meaning and influence of an organization can amplify an initial interpretive advantage without any gain in fidelity to independent evidence *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-275
      - [CLAIM-336](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-336.md) — The pragmatic-transport and will-organization lines describe one model, an organization of operators that act on a shared interpretive state under a context while allocating one another's influence: a frame is the context under which operators act, a judgement is the response they yield, an action-generating regime is an operator or coalition, and a will-organization is the dynamics that allocates influence among them *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-279, CLAIM-286
        - [CLAIM-338](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-338.md) — The selectivity active inference gives action, sampling what one expects to experience, is played in the coupled meaning–authority model by the authority space: influence decides which operators retrieve and so what the next judgement observes, which makes Friston's self-confirming sampling the model's authority-to-interpretation arrow and his agent a coupled loop run without independent scoring *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-297
      - [CLAIM-341](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-341.md) — The loop that keeps a lucid agent's model in touch with what it models runs between judgement and observation: each judgement reshapes the observer whose later observations it then judges, and action on the world is not part of that loop, so active inference's action–perception cycle misplaces where the agent is active *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-275
      - [CLAIM-429](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-429.md) — Where interpretation decides the occasions for cooperation and cooperation's outcomes revise interpretation, an intervention can change the loop's state or its coupling: a favourable exception changes the state and leaves the rule that judges exceptions as it was, while a change in how far outcomes may revise the governing interpretation changes the coupling, and where the coupling does not depend on the state, only the second changes how later evidence is taken *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-330
    - [CLAIM-406](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-406.md) — Structural, pre-emptive testimonial injustice has the form of the record's trust loop: an arrangement that decides whose word is sought can keep an early exclusion going through the indicators of competence that only being sought produces, with no continuing prejudiced act; but the loop alone cannot tell perpetuated privilege from merited expertise, because that needs the prejudice condition the dynamics do not contain *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-330
    - [CLAIM-443](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-443.md) — A learned prior over which processes govern, P(g | z, H) ∝ exp(βQ(g, z) + b_H(g, z)), its bias b_H trained by reward-modulated Hebbian updates to the relations by which one process recruits or endorses another, is a candidate mechanism for durable authority and for amortized governance; but persistence is not amortization, which is shown only when earlier work replaces later computation, communication or recruitment, and a prior over authority differs from a prior over actions only when what is appropriate changes *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-375](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-375.md) — Under one-hop allocation within an epoch, an operator that endorses an ally whose policy is nearer its own than the collective decision is raises how far its preferred policy is realized while its own authority stays fixed, so the two conditions of the endorsement scheme hold together *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-285](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-285.md) — An endorsement scheme that denies each operator control over its own authority can make delegation do work: rewarded for how far their preferred policies are realized and not for authority held, operators delegate to aligned others, and the two conditions need not be confined to one-hop allocation *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-282
- [CLAIM-283](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-283.md) — The precedence a motive claims over action and the authority the rest of the organization grants it are different quantities: a motive can claim control without receiving it, and be granted control it does not claim *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-484](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-484.md) — Internal conflict is the gap between the precedence a motive claims over action and the authority the rest of the organization grants it *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-286](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-286.md) — Habit, akrasia, rumination, rigidity and insight can be modelled as regimes of one organization, in which processes transform shared meaning and allocate one another's influence, with trust, specialization and higher-level agency arising from its history and not imposed *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-287](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-287.md) — What persists when a self persists through inactivity is the capacity to reinstate an organization, not its continuous running, and continuity of that kind can branch and merge, so it is not an identity relation *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-290](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-290.md) — A positive-definite kernel's minimal realizations are unique up to a unitary, and two finite representation matrices with the same centred Gram matrix differ by a translation and an orthogonal map *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-379](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-379.md) — On a finite set of stimuli, regularized linear readouts with ridge b > 0 cannot tell apart two centred representations of the same width exactly when one is an orthogonal transformation of the other, and the unregularized CCA member cannot tell apart representations with the same column space, which differ by an invertible linear map *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-269](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-269.md) — A regularized linear readout can tell apart only representations that differ in normalized kernel, and kernels fix a representation only up to the symmetry of what is observed, so no such readout supplies a distinction beyond that symmetry *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-385
      - [CLAIM-193](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-193.md) — A linear probe family can tell apart only realizations whose representations differ in normalized kernel, and kernels fix a representation only up to the symmetry of what is observed: any distinction beyond that is supplied by the analyst *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-264
- [CLAIM-302](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-302.md) — Equivalence under feasible tests can be much coarser than statistical equivalence: there are ensembles almost disjoint from uniform that no polynomial-size test tells apart from it, and efficiently samplable ensembles of this kind exist if pseudorandom generators do *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-304](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-304.md) — A rendering can keep a distinction recoverable in principle and make it infeasible to recover: if pseudorandom generators exist, a uniformly random bit can be encoded so that an unbounded receiver recovers it except with probability at most 2⁻⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾, while no efficient receiver does non-negligibly better than chance *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-401](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-401.md) — The conditions an effective description is commonly asked to meet are not of one kind: predictive sufficiency and approximation fidelity are adequacy relative to a declared target, metric and horizon; tractability restricts the operations under which adequacy is assessed; dynamical independence and memory closure are relations of the representation to the system, memory relative to a chosen projection; so a matrix over them as independent binary axes conflates kinds *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-152, CLAIM-348, CLAIM-397
- [CLAIM-317](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-317.md) — Self-presentations that differ by audience do no harm while the audiences are kept apart; people keep them apart and script the occasions where they must meet, and broadcast and networked media bring them together unchosen, which is when the presentations collide *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-318](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-318.md) — Within a shared observational scenario, exact structure-preserving symmetries are the invertible members of a nested family of stochastic transports, and among Markov kernels between finite sets the invertible ones are the permutation matrices, so the invertible core is the relabellings, a groupoid in which objects joined by an arrow have isomorphic automorphism groups *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-324](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-324.md) — In the What Survives Translation? exchange, the manuscript drafted straight from the crystallized argument changed the thesis with no turn arguing the move and dropped 24 of that argument's items, none on request, and the second crystallized argument announced its change of question but left items out without saying which had dissolved and which were lost *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-330](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-330.md) — In the coupled meaning–influence model linearized at its symmetric state, with each field stable alone and nonnegative couplings, the coupling destabilizes symmetry exactly when βγ > (1 − α)(1 − δ): only the loop can do it, and the direction that grows mixes meaning and authority *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-340](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-340.md) — Scoring operators on predictions committed before the evidence is not by itself Regime B: in the linearized operator model the coupling of interpretation to endorsement has the sign of κ′ − κ̄, so commitment removes capture only when the interpretation bends the reading of the evidence no more than it bends the predictions, and it keeps the learning that revising after the evidence would lose *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-404](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-404.md) — An organization can be governed from outside without any of its decisions being made for it, through the evidence its own procedures receive or through the criteria by which they weigh evidence; the two routes are distinct and each is possible without the other, so informational and evaluative independence do not imply each other; and where the organization's role is to evaluate another that affects its evidence or resources, the interpretation–authority loop can close between the two institutions, so that formal independence of the evaluator's procedure does not make its evaluation independent *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-330, CLAIM-342, CLAIM-348, CLAIM-410
  - [CLAIM-400](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-400.md) — In the meaning–authority model linearized at symmetry, a third, maintained legibility state that authority moves (ε) and that moves interpretation (ν) or endorsement (μ), with persistence λ < 1 and nonnegative couplings, destabilizes the symmetric state exactly when the two-variable condition holds with β + νε/(1 − λ) in place of β and δ + με/(1 − λ) in place of δ: at the threshold the regime is indistinguishable from stronger two-variable couplings, and the slower it is the more it adds, while away from the threshold it adds a mode that no two-variable model has, so a lean in the regime can outlast the advantages it was built from *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-444](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-444.md) — A replicator dynamic on the distribution of authority among an organization's processes is the special case of the meaning–authority–legibility model in which the organization's interpretation is the authority-weighted mixture of its processes' and evidence reaches scoring without a maintained regime of its own; the replicator tools (Bayesian reading, potential and harmonic games, stochastic stability) then apply, and the record's separate interpretation and legibility states earn their place exactly where interpretation departs from that mixture or legibility keeps a memory of past authority *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-331](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-331.md) — A level of organization has a temporal facet as well as a compositional one: higher-level variables are characteristically slower and longer-lived than the activity that produces them, though slowness is a mark of a level and not its definition *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-423](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-423.md) — In a political collective, components that change at different speeds (attention, coalitions, elected terms, administrative careers, law and treaties, generational memory) are not only nested by timescale: under a given institutional arrangement their different temporal horizons affect which forms of influence each can accumulate, exercise and keep, and so which of them holds authority over the others, so a state can stay continuous as an actor while the organization producing its positions changes under it *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-345](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-345.md) — Equal controllability rank does not fix the cost of control: for x_{t+1} = x_t + b·u the least quadratic effort for a displacement Δ is Δ²/b², unbounded as b → 0 while the system stays controllable, and in general the least effort is Δxᵀ W_T^† Δx, set by the Gramian and not by its rank *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-350](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-350.md) — A coarse-graining preserves a deterministic judgment exactly when the judgment is constant on its fibres: the judgment then factors through the coarse description, uniquely on its image, and otherwise two states the judgment tells apart have been merged *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-407](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-407.md) — A coarse-graining exactly informationally closed under a process's ordinary dynamics need not preserve its responses to an intervention on the mechanism: for a declared intervention distribution ρ, independent of the state, the deficiency Γ = I(S; Y^(I) | T(S), I) can be positive, as in the hidden governance bit, where it is ρ(h = 1) bits; and Γ = 0 exactly when, for every intervention ρ charges, the response kernels are constant on T's fibres over the states of positive probability *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-399](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-399.md) — Causal abstraction in the senses of Rubenstein et al., Beckers and Halpern, and Beckers, Eberhardt and Halpern does not secure governance-response sufficiency: exact transformation, τ-abstraction and zero approximate-abstraction distance all accept the hidden-bit coarse-graining, which loses ρ(h = 1) bits of the response to h, because each lets high-level noise carry what the coarse state drops; for one outcome and the identity correspondence, sufficiency is their compatibility condition with the high-level context fixed to the coarse state, and strong abstraction rejects the case only through interventions on the hidden parameter *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-409](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-409.md) — For one state law, one intervention distribution and one outcome, a deficiency of sufficiency cannot increase under refinement: if T₁ = g∘T₂ then Γ(T₂) ≤ Γ(T₁); informational closure, by contrast, is monotone in neither direction, since in the three-bit chain of Rosas et al. (2024) A is closed, its refinement (A, B) is not and the full state refining that is closed again, while A⊕B, a coarsening of (A, B), is not closed either; closure fails to be monotone because refining a description changes the future it must predict as well as the evidence, so Blackwell dominance, which every deterministic refinement has over its coarsening, does not order closure *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-365](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-365.md) — On a norm-ball update set the local frustration residual Φ_r = min over ‖d‖ ≤ r of max_i(ε_i + g_iᵀd) equals the maximum over the simplex of Σλ_iε_i − r‖Σλ_ig_i‖_*, so infeasibility of the declared improvements has a certificate, and any admissible actual update exceeds Φ_r by a nonnegative governance regret *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-371](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-371.md) — Under the componentwise order on distortion profiles, two profiles are incomparable exactly when they trade off, and then positive weightings can rank them either way, while every positive weighting agrees with a dominance *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-385](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-385.md) — If a symmetric operator on ℝⁿ commutes with an orthogonal representation of a compact group, each eigenspace is a sum of real irreducibles and each multiplicity a sum of multiples of their dimensions, so SO(2) and ℤ/n for n ≥ 3 force paired eigenvalues; conversely the spectrum fixes neither the group nor a basis inside an eigenspace *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-397](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-397.md) — For a scalar stationary process with autocovariance C, the Mori–Zwanzig memory kernels for the projection onto the current value are fixed by C alone, through C(m+1) = Σ_{k≤m} c_k C(m−k); the memory vanishes iff C is geometric, and when C has finite Hankel rank d the memory has Hankel rank exactly d − 1 *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-414](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-414.md) — Matched ordinary trajectories can conceal differences in an interpretation's efficacy, in the allocation of that efficacy, and in the maintenance of its enabling constraints: in two finite constructions, systems that agree under ordinary operation differ in each, and a specified intervention exposes the difference that passive observation of the matched trajectories does not *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-417](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-417.md) — What the record explained by "self" in its dispositional, persisting, self-governing and integrated senses is better explained by organizational perspectives, with a perspective, its carriers, its lineage and its representations kept apart; the subject sense stays a separate question, and narrative, presented and modeled selves involve representations that may describe a perspective, attribute it to a bearer or construct an owner, none of them the perspective itself *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-025](../record/arguments.d/ARG-025.md)
  - [CLAIM-427](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-427.md) — Evidence for the organizational-perspective framework comes in three grades: that different organizations produce the same ordinary behaviour, that they respond differently to independently specified interventions, and that a model representing the coupling of significance, authority and reproduction predicts those responses better than the strongest existing alternatives at matched complexity; only the third bears on the framework's defeater, and no grade counts if success is defined in the framework's own terms *(Superseded)*
- [CLAIM-415](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-415.md) — A person can be organized by a judgement they attribute to a collective that does not hold it: the audience in a self-model can be a false unity, and a judgement can shape a person who rejects it, because resisting it makes it consequential *(Proposed)*
- [CLAIM-419](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-419.md) — The record's grammar is fixed at any moment but amendable by decision, and in practice a move that fit no scheme or relation has repeatedly been treated as a defect of the grammar and answered by amending it, so a move the grammar cannot hold is not only forced or lost; whether every such move is caught is not shown *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-469](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-469.md) — Luria is an apparatus for a record's objects in the operational sense: through its schemes, vocabularies, validators and generated views it realizes a system of distinctions that fixes what counts as a referable and governable object within the record, so that a split scheme makes one object two and a promoted vocabulary makes a value an entity; it keeps, enforces and propagates those distinctions; and its distinctions are revised through the record's own use *(Active)* — also rests on CLAIM-479
- [CLAIM-436](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-436.md) — An instantaneous ordering is a common currency on a finite set of options, where every complete preorder has a real-valued representation, but not in general: the lexicographic order on the unit square has no real-valued representation, while a continuous complete preorder on a connected separable space has a continuous one; so admitting an ordering is strictly weaker than admitting a currency, a graded lexicographic override lies in the gap while an exact threshold override does not, a threshold override with a discrimination threshold is a lexicographic semiorder whose choices can cycle and so is no ordering at all, and even where each instant has a currency, successive currencies need not share exchange rates *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-479](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-479.md) — In the record a typed relation is more constrained than either of its relata: a claim's content is open prose, while `rests_on` fixes the scheme at both ends, has `supports` written as its converse and says what retiring its target leaves, and none of that moves when either claim's content does; so a relation's rigidity is a fact about the grammar, not evidence that the dependency it records is sound *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-486](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-486.md) — A rendering can keep the communicative act while changing the proposition, so preserving the proposition is not necessary for preserving the communicative event *(Proposed)*

### From If a map approximately intertwines two operators, with defects E_A = ΦA − A′Φ and E_B = ΦB − B′Φ, then Φ[A,B] − [A′,B′]Φ = A′E_B + E_A B − B′E_A − E_B A, so the commutator is carried to within (‖A‖ + ‖A′‖)‖E_B‖ + (‖B‖ + ‖B′‖)‖E_A‖

- [CLAIM-373](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-373.md) — If a map approximately intertwines two operators, with defects E_A = ΦA − A′Φ and E_B = ΦB − B′Φ, then Φ[A,B] − [A′,B′]Φ = A′E_B + E_A B − B′E_A − E_B A, so the commutator is carried to within (‖A‖ + ‖A′‖)‖E_B‖ + (‖B‖ + ‖B′‖)‖E_A‖ *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-063](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-063.md) — A transport that approximately intertwines each framing operation approximately preserves their commutator, so the degree to which interpretive perspectives interfere can itself be part of what a translation preserves; on observed responses that degree is the order effect, which the intertwining defects bound only with a readout defect added and which the data identify only through observational distortion *(Proposed)* — through [ARG-006](../record/arguments.d/ARG-006.md)

### From On a finite set of outcomes, some function rises with every move that wins one of a negotiation's conflicts exactly when no chain of winning moves returns to where it began, and the length of the longest such chain ending at an outcome is one such function; a perfectly transitive record of which side won each pair, in a complete tournament contesting every pair once, leaves a cyclic share of (n − 2)/3n under the Hodge decomposition, a baseline that does not carry to sparse records; the Hodge gradient can reverse a comparison the wins settle, netting a record erases alternation, a record fixes a class of potentials rather than one, a coherent record is not yet one aligned with any single perspective's ordering, a best-fitting ordering of a cycle is no Lyapunov function, the sign a class of potentials gives can be set-valued, and an ordering fitted to a record overstates its agreement there

- [CLAIM-434](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-434.md) — On a finite set of outcomes, some function rises with every move that wins one of a negotiation's conflicts exactly when no chain of winning moves returns to where it began, and the length of the longest such chain ending at an outcome is one such function; a perfectly transitive record of which side won each pair, in a complete tournament contesting every pair once, leaves a cyclic share of (n − 2)/3n under the Hodge decomposition, a baseline that does not carry to sparse records; the Hodge gradient can reverse a comparison the wins settle, netting a record erases alternation, a record fixes a class of potentials rather than one, a coherent record is not yet one aligned with any single perspective's ordering, a best-fitting ordering of a cycle is no Lyapunov function, the sign a class of potentials gives can be set-valued, and an ordering fitted to a record overstates its agreement there *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-451](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-451.md) — When an organization's record of winning moves cycles, the failure is organizational nonintegrability, distinct from a perspective's own preference instability and from switching of the governing regime; it becomes organizational tension only when realized as costly reversal against demands the organization maintains, and cognitive dissonance only when that tension is detected and appraised as aversive; learning can relieve it by accommodation, by entrenched precedence or by cheap periodic coordination, which observed coherence does not tell apart, and ambivalence and nonintegrability entail neither one another *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-482](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-482.md) — An organization's aggregate revealed preference exists exactly when its record of winning moves never cycles, and where it exists it is fitted to one regime of authority, so an intervention on authority that changes the winning moves changes the fitted preference and the preference does not predict the change *(Active)*

### From Inquiry is a form of specification: a question fixes which differences would count as an answer, an inquiry adds the operations that make those differences accessible, and what it finds can stabilize into a specification that constrains later inquiry; so inquiry stands to its findings as a specification to its realizations, with one difference, that an inquiry can revise what an answer could be

- [CLAIM-470](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-470.md) — Inquiry is a form of specification: a question fixes which differences would count as an answer, an inquiry adds the operations that make those differences accessible, and what it finds can stabilize into a specification that constrains later inquiry; so inquiry stands to its findings as a specification to its realizations, with one difference, that an inquiry can revise what an answer could be *(Active)*
  - [CLAIM-475](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-475.md) — Specifying is itself a resource-bounded realization: formulating a question takes time, concepts and computation as realizing a configuration takes energy and matter, so the questions an agent can ask are a product of what it has already realized; a stabilized specification is past inquiry stored so that later questions become cheaper to ask, and it can make other questions harder *(Active)*
    - [CLAIM-474](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md) — From interconnection to individuation, five relationships are distinct achievements and none implies the next: interconnection fixes what joint behaviour is possible, compatibility which local descriptions admit a coherent whole, dynamics which compatible, frustrated or differentiated organizations persist, individuation which persistent organizations have sufficiently robust identity and boundaries, organizational autonomy being the further question which of those also help maintain their own constitutive constraints, and inquiry which of them can measure and revise their own models and apparatuses under resource bounds; the research program is to find the conditions for each transition *(Proposed)* — also rests on CLAIM-470, CLAIM-471, CLAIM-480, CLAIM-481
- [CLAIM-471](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md) — Physical interconnection can generate effective constraints on joint behaviour; measurement can establish correspondences among local descriptions; and adaptive apparatuses can revise those correspondences; gluing expresses compatibility under specified relations, but neither the relations' physical generation nor their adequacy follows from gluing alone *(Proposed)*
  - [CLAIM-473](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-473.md) — Coupling locally described systems necessarily induces a separation of time scales between their collective behaviour and their relative behaviour *(Rejected)*
- [CLAIM-480](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md) — Composing interactions can turn an interior into a constraint, and sometimes into a constraint of a new kind: in the chain E = ½k₁(x₁ − x₂)² + ½k₂(x₂ − x₃)², with x₂ internal and equilibrated, the boundary sees E_eff = ½·k₁k₂/(k₁ + k₂)·(x₁ − x₃)², a coupling between x₁ and x₃ that neither part has; if the interior relaxes slowly, eliminating it leaves a history-dependent constraint, a memory kernel, so interconnection fixes an effective constraint on the boundary's trajectories and separation of time scales decides only whether that constraint is approximately memoryless; and for cellular sheaves the reduced constraint can relate three boundary values where every relation among the parts is pairwise *(Active)*
- [CLAIM-481](../record/claims.d/CLAIM-481.md) — Coupling does not by itself separate time scales: two identical undamped oscillators coupled with stiffness k have normal modes at ω₀ and √(ω₀² + 2k), nearly equal when k ≪ ω₀², and neither decays; separation comes where the coupling dissipates relative differences faster than collective ones, as in ẋ = −ax − k(x − y), ẏ = −ay − k(y − x), whose collective and relative modes relax at rates a and a + 2k, and in a Laplacian flow ẋ = −κLx, where the spectrum of L sets the rates *(Active)*
